domains_methodology: Live, resolving publication domains measured 2026-08-18 (_status/domain_ns_map_20260818.tsv): 212 CNAME entries exist, of which 43 are NXDOMAIN (never registered) and 16 resolve to third parties we do not own. 153 serve our content.
pages_methodology: Total HTML pages across the Bankruptcy Transparency Network, English + Spanish + German + Polish + French + Italian. Last full count 2026-05-23: 48,977 active pages (openbankruptcyproject.org 37,854 + statute-sites 10,339 + 1328f.com 784, excluding stale backups and not-owned mirrors). Spanish layer: 3,000+.
national_rate_basis: Chapter 13, FJC Integrated Database 2008-2024. Denominator is TERMINATED cases, not filings. Independently recomputed 2026-08-22 from pacer/data/fjc_national.db (COUNT(DISTINCT casekey); discharge = d1fdsp IN ('A','B')): 1,745,060 of 4,282,561 terminated = 40.7% discharge / 59.3% non-discharge. Direction CONFIRMED; the ~1pt delta is an open reconcile item. Published figures held at 58.3/41.7 per the standing do-not-bump rule.
